articles.title: Pokémon Turns 30 — and Pikachu's Party Is Still Going
articles.summary: Pokémon just turned 30! It started in Japan on February 27, 1996, with two video games. Now it's the world's most valuable media franchise, and 50,000 fans partied at the World Championships in San Francisco.

articles.title: This AI Just Beat the Best Humans at a Game of Secret Identities
articles.summary: MIT and other researchers built an AI that beat top human players at Stratego, a board game where you can't see your opponent's pieces. It's cheaper to train than older AI and could help with real-world problems like cybersecurity.

articles.title: Djokovic Wins First Match Since Wimbledon at China Open
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic beat Nuno Borges at the China Open for his first win since July. The 39-year-old needed a medical timeout for his shoulder but still won in straight sets. It was his 30th straight victory in Beijing.
